definitions.explanation: A social group bound by shared ancestry, customs, and territory. Used in anthropological, historical, and geographical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部族|ぶぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: Many tribes live in this region.

examples.japanese: {部族|ぶぞく}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{部族|ぶぞく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That tribe continues to preserve its own language and culture.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (section, group) and {族|ぞく} (clan, tribe).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部族|ぶぞく}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ (between tribes, intertribal)
- {部族|ぶぞく}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (tribal society)
- {部族|ぶぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長|おさ} (tribal chief)
- ⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧{部族|ぶぞく} (minority tribe)
- {遊牧|ゆうぼく}{部族|ぶぞく} (nomadic tribe)

Primarily used when discussing indigenous peoples, historical societies, or anthropological topics. In modern Japanese, ⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧ (ethnic group, people) is the broader and more common term. {部族|ぶぞく} specifically implies a smaller, more localized group with shared kinship ties.
